state_rank_note: 4th most dangerous state for people walking (after New Mexico, Louisiana, and Arizona). Down one spot from the prior edition, but a better rank does NOT mean safer roads — SC fatalities rose; other states' rates rose faster.
framing: South Carolina consistently ranks among the most dangerous states in the nation for people walking. Pedestrian deaths are concentrated in, but not limited to, its largest metros; the county view below shows the statewide distribution.

sources.title: SC drops to 4th most-dangerous state for pedestrians, but fatalities are on the rise (Post & Courier)
